title: Conformal limits of all mixed Ising spin and energy correlations
exact_target: For a finite-range perturbation of the square-lattice Ising Hamiltonian by an admissible even interaction V, do all mixed bulk spin and energy correlations at one common critical $\beta _c(\lambda )$ converge for small |lambda| to the unperturbed conformal correlation functions, multiplied by nonzero spin and energy normalizations? Quantify every distinct interior point tuple, free or constant-spin boundary, and the infinite-plane periodic-box state, with conformal weights 1/8 for spins and 1 for energy.
